scope: existing Codex++ Auto Follow-up and Codex Follow-up migration package; no live plugin mutation

regression.before: isolated restore reproduces source_path mismatch: the historical plugin contract assumes the old user default root and a developer Junction
regression.after: bind source/runtime to the chosen migration layout; use the existing validator to compare all eight Auto Follow-up files; native install/update state stays target-local

positive_paths: new temporary Windows user and separate Codex++ profile with spaces and Chinese characters
native validation from both the source directory and its identical physical installed copy
target installer state absent without copying or fabricating old state
native renderer storage key export/import and legacy editable-prompt migration
export has no writes; successful import preserves target session state and other plugin keys
negative_paths: changed installed source copy is rejected
disabled Codex Follow-up companion is rejected
developer-link --repair on packaged copies is rejected without writes
old session fields, unknown plugin/field and invalid preference types are rejected before writes
partial localStorage write failure restores previous values

limits: Native Electron desktop pages and actual automatic continuation were not exercised on a different physical computer.

Preference transport is opt-in through the existing renderer localStorage protocol; tests use an in-memory storage fixture and a browser-like VM context. Actual source settings are private and were not read or committed by this agent.
When developer tools are unavailable, the guide provides the existing native settings-page migration path.
New sessions begin with new counters and per-session switches; old queues, caches, candidates, sessions and credentials are excluded.
This request changes the migration package only; the source machine historical native contract remains unchanged.

review.mode: producer review and executable positive/negative tests
